**ExxonMobil's operating cash flow fell about 16.7% from Q1 2024 to Q4 2024.** The Q4 figure is my estimate, derived by subtraction rather than taken from a reported quarterly statement, and the other figures are recalled rather than checked against the filings.

| Period | Net cash from operating activities |
|---|---|
| Q1 2024 (10-Q) | ≈ $14,662 million |
| Q2 2024 | ≈ $10,573 million |
| Q3 2024 | ≈ $17,569 million |
| Full year 2024 (10-K) | ≈ $55,022 million |

**Q4 2024:** $55,022 − $14,662 − $10,573 − $17,569 ≈ **$12,218 million**. This matches the roughly $12.2 billion I recall being reported for the quarter.

**Change:** ($12,218 − $14,662) / $14,662 ≈ −16.7%.
